label: Plasma welder
note: Issue #722: the plasma welder, a tool on weapon wheel slot 7 (key 7). 'must_own': drawn only while you carry it. T-89 gives you one the first time you talk to him in a story save (t89.json 'welder_gift'); free roam starts with one (story main.json free_roam_kit). With it drawn, fire makes it spit sparks and arc (no damage). 'weld': weld_s, seconds of holding E (or fire, with it drawn) beside something it can fix (a WeldSpot within reach m): a damaged speeder (fire only: E mounts it), a desert droid wreck (now needs the welder), a knocked-out droid of yours, your wrecked ship on the pit pad (ship_flasks of flask_item, used up, instead of T-89's fee). Mid-race, crashed out (#720), hold E in the seat for weld_s and you are back at full hull; without the welder the race's patch-up puts you back at unwelded_hull (share of full). Why 10 flasks: T-89's rebuild is 500 cr, about 300 of it parts; at 45 cr a flask that is about 7 flasks, and 10 are worth 900 to the fence: nearly twice his price, a big tax for doing it yourself.
